meta.note: Master medicine DB for Suraksha Parchi. Mirrors NeonDB drug_master. brands[] maps shop names to generic key.

medicines.name: paracetamol
medicines.hi: Bukhar/dard ke liye. Khane ke baad 1 goli, din me max 3-4g. Do Paracetamol brand ek saath mat lo.
medicines.bn: Jor/byathar jonno. Khabar pore 1 ta, dine max 3-4g. Duto brand eksathe neben na.
medicines.mr: Taap/dukhisathi. Jevnanantar 1 goli, divsat max 3-4g. Don brand ekatra naka.

medicines.name: ibuprofen
medicines.hi: Dard/sujan ke liye. Khane ke baad hi lo, khali pet nahi. BP/sugar dawai wale doctor se poochhein.
medicines.bn: Byatha/fola r jonno. Khabar pore neben, khali pete noy.
medicines.mr: Dukhi/sujisathi. Jevnanantarach ghya, rikamya poti naka.

medicines.name: diclofenac
medicines.hi: Jod/kamar dard ke liye. Khane ke baad, lamba course doctor se.
medicines.bn: Gire byathar jonno. Khabar pore.

medicines.name: aspirin
medicines.hi: Dil ke liye khoon patla karne wali. Roz 1, doctor ke bina band mat karo.
medicines.bn: Heart er jonno. Doctor na bolle bondho noy.

medicines.name: mefenamic-acid
medicines.hi: Mahwari dard ke liye. Khane ke baad, 2-3 din se zyada to doctor.
medicines.bn: Period byathar jonno. Khabar pore.

medicines.name: azithromycin
medicines.hi: Infection maarne ke liye. Roz 1 goli 3-5 din, course pura karo, beech me band mat karo.
medicines.bn: Infection marar jonno. Roz 1 ta 3-5 din, course sesh koro.
medicines.mr: Sansarg nasht karasathi. Roz 1 goli 3-5 divas, course purna kara.

medicines.name: amoxicillin
medicines.hi: Gale/chhati infection ke liye. 5 din course pura. Daane/khujli ho to turant doctor.
medicines.bn: Gola/buker infection. 5 din course. Rash hole doctor.
medicines.mr: Ghasa sansarg. 5 divas course. Purad aalyas doctor.

medicines.name: amoxiclav
medicines.hi: Tez infection ke liye. Khane ke saath, course pura. Dast ho sakta hai.
medicines.bn: Joralo infection. Khabar sathe, course sesh.

medicines.name: cefixime
medicines.hi: Typhoid/peshab infection ke liye. Roz 1-2, 7 din course pura.
medicines.bn: Typhoid/prosrab infection. 7 din course.

medicines.name: ciprofloxacin
medicines.hi: Peshab/pet infection ke liye. Doodh/iron ke saath mat lo, 2 ghante gap.
medicines.bn: Prosrab/pet infection. Dudh/iron sathe noy.

medicines.name: doxycycline
medicines.hi: Infection ke liye. Paani ke saath khade hokar lo, dhoop se bacho.
medicines.bn: Infection er jonno. Jol diye neben.

medicines.name: metronidazole
medicines.hi: Pet ke infection/dast ke liye. Dawai ke saath sharab BILKUL nahi.
medicines.bn: Pet infection/dast. Osudh cholakalin mod noy.
medicines.mr: Pot sansarg. Aushadhadarmyan daru ajibat naka.

medicines.name: albendazole
medicines.hi: Pet ke kide ke liye. 1 goli, 6 mahine baad repeat. Poora parivar le.
medicines.bn: Krimir jonno. 1 ta, 6 mash pore abar.

medicines.name: metformin
medicines.hi: Sugar control ke liye. Khane ke saath, meetha kam, roz 30 min walk.
medicines.bn: Sugar niyontron er jonno. Khabar sathe.

medicines.name: glimepiride
medicines.hi: Sugar ki dawai, nashte se pehle. Pasina/kampan = low sugar, turant meetha lo.
medicines.bn: Sugar er osudh, jolkhabar age. Gham/kanpuni = low sugar.
medicines.mr: Sakharechi goli, nashtyaadhi. Gham/tharthar = low sugar.

medicines.name: sitagliptin
medicines.hi: Sugar ke liye. Roz 1, khana khao ya na khao.
medicines.bn: Sugar er jonno. Roz 1 ta.

medicines.name: insulin-glargine
medicines.hi: Sugar ka injection, roz same time. Dose khud mat badlo, fridge me rakho.
medicines.bn: Sugar er injection. Nije dose bodlaben na.
medicines.mr: Sakharache injection. Dose swataha badlu naka.

medicines.name: losartan
medicines.hi: High BP ke liye. Roz subah 1, namak kam. Chakkar aaye to baith jao.
medicines.bn: High BP er jonno. Roz sokale 1, lobon kom.
medicines.mr: High BP sathi. Roz sakali 1, meeth kami.

medicines.name: telmisartan
medicines.hi: High BP ke liye. Roz 1, pregnant mahila NA le.
medicines.bn: High BP er jonno. Gorvoboti neben na.
medicines.mr: High BP sathi. Garbhavati ne gheu naye.

medicines.name: amlodipine
medicines.hi: BP ke liye. Pair me sujan ho sakti hai, to doctor ko batao.
medicines.bn: BP er jonno. Pa fola hote pare.
medicines.mr: BP sathi. Payala suj aalyas sanga.

medicines.name: atenolol
medicines.hi: BP/dil ki dhadkan ke liye. Achanak band mat karo.
medicines.bn: BP er jonno. Hothat bondho noy.

medicines.name: hydrochlorothiazide
medicines.hi: Peshab badhane wali BP dawai. Subah lo, raat ko nahi.
medicines.bn: Prosrab barano BP osudh. Sokale neben.
medicines.mr: Lagvi vadhavnari BP goli. Sakali ghya.

medicines.name: enalapril
medicines.hi: BP/dil ke liye. Sukhi khansi ho to doctor ko batao.
medicines.bn: BP er jonno. Shukno kashi hole doctor.
medicines.mr: BP sathi. Korada khokla aalyas sanga.

medicines.name: atorvastatin
medicines.hi: Cholesterol ke liye. Raat ko 1, tel-masala kam. Maanspeshiyon me dard rahe to doctor.
medicines.bn: Cholesterol er jonno. Raate 1.

medicines.name: rosuvastatin
medicines.hi: Cholesterol ke liye. Raat ko 1.
medicines.bn: Cholesterol er jonno. Raate 1.

medicines.name: omeprazole
medicines.hi: Acidity ke liye. Subah khali pet 1, 2-4 hafte.
medicines.bn: Acidity er jonno. Sokale khali pete.

medicines.name: pantoprazole
medicines.hi: Acidity ke liye. Subah khali pet.
medicines.bn: Acidity er jonno. Sokale khali pete.

medicines.name: antacid
medicines.hi: Gas/acidity me turant aaram. Khane ke baad 2 chammach.
medicines.bn: Gas/acidity te aram. Khabar pore.

medicines.name: ondansetron
medicines.hi: Ulti rokne ke liye. Jeebh par ghulne wali, paani nahi chahiye.
medicines.bn: Bomi bondher jonno.

medicines.name: loperamide
medicines.hi: Dast rokne ke liye. Saath me ORS zaroor piyo. Khooni dast me NA lo.
medicines.bn: Dast bondher jonno. Sathe ORS. Rokto dast e neben na.
medicines.mr: Julaab thambvanyasathi. Sobat ORS. Raktajulaab asalyas naka.

medicines.name: ors
medicines.hi: Dast/ulti me paani ki kami. Uble paani me ghol ke thoda-thoda piyo.
medicines.bn: Dast/bomi te jol ghatti. Futano jole gule khan.
medicines.mr: Panyachi kamtarta. Ukalalelya panyat gholun pya.

medicines.name: cetirizine
medicines.hi: Chheenk/khujli ke liye. Raat ko 1, neend aa sakti hai, gaadi mat chalao.
medicines.bn: Hanchi/chulkani. Raate 1, ghum aste pare.

medicines.name: levocetirizine
medicines.hi: Allergy ke liye, kam neend wali. Raat ko 1.
medicines.bn: Allergy er jonno. Raate 1.

medicines.name: montelukast
medicines.hi: Dama/allergy ke liye. Roz raat ko 1, attack me inhaler hi kaam karega.
medicines.bn: Hapani/allergy. Roz raate 1.

medicines.name: salbutamol-inhaler
medicines.hi: Dama attack me turant aaram. Technique seekho, hafte me 2+ baar lage to doctor.
medicines.bn: Hapani attack e aram.

medicines.name: cough-syrup
medicines.hi: Khansi ke liye. Raat ko 2 chammach. 2 hafte se zyada khansi = TB test.
medicines.bn: Kashir jonno. 2 soptaho besi = TB test.

medicines.name: levothyroxine
medicines.hi: Thyroid ke liye. Subah khali pet, doodh/chai se 1hr gap. Roz same time.
medicines.bn: Thyroid er jonno. Sokale khali pete.

medicines.name: iron-folic
medicines.hi: Khoon badhane ke liye. Roz 1, chai ke saath mat lo, nimbu ke saath lo.
medicines.bn: Rokto baranor jonno. Cha sathe noy.

medicines.name: vitamin-d3
medicines.hi: Haddiyon ke liye. Hafte me 1 (doctor dose), doodh ke saath.
medicines.bn: Harer jonno. Soptahe 1.

medicines.name: vitamin-b12
medicines.hi: Nas/kamzori ke liye. Roz 1, shakahariyon ke liye zaroori.
medicines.bn: Snayu/durbolota. Roz 1.

medicines.name: calcium
medicines.hi: Haddiyon ke liye. Khane ke saath, iron se alag time par lo.
medicines.bn: Harer jonno. Iron theke alada somoy.

medicines.name: zinc
medicines.hi: Bacchon ke dast me ORS ke saath 10-14 din.
medicines.bn: Bachchader dast e ORS sathe.

medicines.name: antifungal-cream
medicines.hi: Daad/khajli par. Saaf-sukhi rakho, 2-4 hafte lagao, beech me mat chhodo.
medicines.bn: Dad/chulkani te. 2-4 soptaho lagan.

medicines.name: chloroquine
medicines.hi: Malaria ke liye. Test ke baad hi, course pura. Bukhar wapas aaye to turant hospital.
medicines.bn: Malaria r jonno. Test er por, course sesh.
medicines.mr: Hivtap sathi. Chachani nanter, course purna.

medicines.name: tb-dots
medicines.hi: TB ka 6 mahine course. 1 din bhi miss mat karo, DOTS center se muft milti hai.
medicines.bn: TB r 6 masher course. Miss noy, DOTS theke free.
medicines.mr: Kshayarogacha 6 mahinyancha course. Chukvu naka, DOTS madhun mofat.

medicines.name: prednisolone
medicines.hi: Steroid — doctor dose se kam-zyada mat karo, achanak band mat karo.
medicines.bn: Steroid — nije kom-besi noy.

medicines.name: multivitamin
medicines.hi: Kamzori ke liye. Roz 1 khane ke baad. Khana hi asli dawai hai.
medicines.bn: Durbolotar jonno. Roz 1.

medicines.name: eye-drop
medicines.hi: Aankhon ki jalan/sukhapn ke liye. Din me 2-3 baar 1 boond.
medicines.bn: Chokh jolay. Dine 2-3 bar.

medicines.name: pain-gel
medicines.hi: Dard par lagane wala gel. Din me 2-3 baar, aankh me na lage.
medicines.bn: Byathay laganor gel.
